articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Stocks to Watch Afterhours: Southwest, Tesla, IBM, ServiceNow. ↗️ Tesla (TSLA): Tesla surprised Wall Street with better profits and $1.4 billion in free cash flow. Tesla shares initially rose as much as 4.4% in after-market trading, then retreated after CEO Elon Musk’s call with investors and analysts ended. Related tickers mentioned: IBM, LULU, LUV, NKE, NOW.

articles.title: Optimus 3: Musk teases plans for unveiling
articles.mainIdea: Optimus 3: Musk teases plans for unveiling
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Optimus 3: Musk teases plans for unveiling. Tesla (TSLA) reported first quarter results on Wednesday after the closing bell. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) came in at $0.41 (compared to analyst estimates of $0.34), and revenue came in at $22.39 billion (compared to analyst estimates of $22.19 billion). On the earnings call, CEO Elon Musk projects that Tesla's Optimus humanoid robot will become the "biggest product ever," with production starting in Fremont later this year and expanding to Giga Texas by summer 2027.
